title_template: {work_unit_id} — Execute Human-by-Exception steady-state under existing authority only
goal: Execute and validate at least two fresh Human-by-Exception steady-state iterations using only already-canonical delegated authority, with at most one delegated transaction per iteration, exact cross-iteration Provider Truth/readback chaining, and no replay or authority expansion.
scope: execute at least two fresh Human-by-Exception steady-state iterations
re-evaluate fresh Provider Truth, control-loop, execution admission and operationalization for every iteration
permit at most one delegated transaction per iteration and only through an exact already-canonical authority
prove exact fresh readback after each delegated transaction before any next iteration
prove cross-iteration Provider Truth chaining without stale decision reuse
preserve OWNER_ESCALATION_REQUIRED as out-of-band owner-visible no-mutation no-replay behavior
preserve WAIT_ONLY as no-mutation no-replay behavior
preserve SEPARATE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED and BLOCKED as fail-closed behavior
forbidden_scope: create, infer or broaden provider-state, issue, branch, pull-request, merge, runtime, product, release, ruleset, ADWF or higher-autonomy authority
batch multiple delegated transactions into one iteration
advance to a next iteration before exact fresh readback is complete
reuse stale Provider Truth, control-loop, execution admission or operationalization decisions
automatically replay owner escalation, WAIT, STOP, separate-authority or BLOCKED outcomes
mutate product/runtime source or physical runtime
mutate ADWF binding/repository, release/tag/promotion, ruleset/security policy, PRIVATE evidence or 1080/1081 lifecycle
exit_criteria: at least two iterations are evidenced with fresh per-iteration inputs
no iteration contains more than one delegated transaction
every performed delegated transaction has exact fresh readback before the next iteration
cross-iteration Provider Truth chain is exact and stale reuse is absent
automatic continuation remains limited to explicit already-canonical delegated authority
owner escalation, WAIT, STOP, separate-authority and BLOCKED remain distinct no-mutation/fail-closed outcomes
execution grants no new mutation authority
exact-head hosted CI passes with no product/runtime, ADWF or 1080/1081 mutation
